scope: Explicit experimental Team task/command journal and leased continuation. No production task admission, Main background host or UI cutover.

storage.installation: Explicit migrate only; parent Store factories lazily load modules, check owner lifetime before and after import, and do not migrate.
storage.transactionBoundary: No HTTP, model or arbitrary async callback inside SQLite transaction. PostgreSQL BEGIN is inside rollback try/finally; metadata row is shared-locked for writes.

continuationSemantics: Frozen intent captures tenant, space, issuer actor/principal, exact Office plan, source Thread revision, response mode, Goal intent and Tool permission mode. It is data, not an execution grant.
Thread and Office membership/target/responsibility match stored authority on fresh creation. Same task identity with changed intent rejects; no public Task API was added.

Every mutation records its operation, original arguments and stable per-task idempotency key before dispatch. Receipt settlement follows actual response, with immutable request/receipt conflicts rejected.
Context, initial/paused Goal, stage Thread revisions and selected assistant output are immutable stage observations. Nonterminal Run reads stay live; only terminal replies settle their observation.
Preparing an effect and extending its existing lease share one transaction. Epoch/owner/lease checks reject an expired or replaced writer; no new idempotency key is generated on takeover.

Cancellation blocks new prepare/renew and is not swallowed by transient status-read retries. Existing prepared work may still settle while its current lease is valid; this is not child cancellation propagation.
SQL NULL distinguishes an unsettled response from a settled JSON null. Unknown work is never evicted to meet count or byte budgets.
finalAccepted stores the original admission receipt after qualified real main Run lookup. It is not model completion; actual Run/Transcript remains authoritative.
runtimeEvidence: Real Store, SDK, Control HTTP, Worker pool and Kernel on SQLite and PostgreSQL. Synthetic model transport; no real provider or external Tool side effects.

Planner Run, worker Run, manager final Turn and member final Turn each commit through real HTTP before a deliberately lost response. Close original parent Store and Control, expire the lease, reopen independent Store/Control and use a new owner/epoch.

The restarted coordinator reuses identical original body/key. Already sampled Runs are not sampled again; main transcript contains one original input and one final answer. Planned/member modes use five unique model Runs including the seed; other modes use four.

Goal pause loss preserves the initial null snapshot and original mutation body; restored children run while the same Goal is paused, and only the final main Turn resumes it. Explicit user pause and Run cancel retain existing semantics.

Concurrent lease claim has one winner. A stale owner cannot settle an unknown effect. Wrong principal, changed intent/effect, foreign space, forged Office Agent and malformed/accessor profiles reject without launching new work.
Caller mutation after create starts does not alter the frozen intent. Partial/future schema rejects without repair or downgrade.

Both child models are gated during a live cancellation. Pending Run observations are unsettled, cancellation promptly stops the coordinator without final submission or exhausting read retries. Test explicitly cancels child Runs afterward: propagation has not been implemented.
Existing Team tests retain parallel execution, failed-member manager recovery, bounded report truncation, Goal semantics, running SSE disconnect/reopen/resume and completed history convergence.
correctionsDuringDevelopment: Initial parameter properties passed TypeScript but failed Node strip-only execution. Replaced with explicit fields; no new transform flags or build system.
SQLite STRICT uses INTEGER for lease milliseconds, while PostgreSQL uses BIGINT. No SQLite transaction awaits external work.

Actual ordinary Run snapshots may omit purpose for compatibility. Final qualification normalizes omitted purpose to turn exactly as existing projection/Store validation; explicit non-turn purposes remain rejected.
Lease extension and effect preparation were combined to avoid a separate renewal transaction per operation.
remainingBeforeProduction: Atomic trusted admission, current Office/Run/tenant authorization and exact retained deployment binding.
Main Thread reservation/fork source head and Goal identity controls across ordinary writes and concurrent windows.
Persistent wait/terminal wake, bounded dispatch/discovery, task failure/deadline/budget handling and host shutdown lifecycle.
Unknown-command cancellation reconciliation and complete child/final Run cancellation propagation. Journal fences do not retract already-dispatched HTTP effects.
Task snapshot/progress/result/approval API and actual UI cutover, retirement of renderer Team orchestration, real Main/process and installed-product acceptance.
Remaining original goal: default desktop Workflow configuration, production request identity, Tool resource/lifetime consolidation, autonomous subagents and installed-plugin full acceptance.
claimsNotMade: No complete Team scheduler or production activation
No OS-process kill/restart proof: coordinator interruption and Store/Control reopening are explicit in-process fault injection
No product speed improvement, whole-repository, full UI, installed desktop or real-account/model acceptance
